standard_prerequisites.name: The resolution property descends along approximations, so the statement reduces to Noetherian schemes
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the Noetherian hypothesis used later via the derived category equivalence.

standard_prerequisites.name: A morphism is affine as soon as the inverse images of the affine opens of the target are affine, equivalently R^1 of the pushforward of every quasi-coherent module vanishes
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces affinity of the diagonal to the vanishing of R^1j_* for inclusions of affine opens.

standard_prerequisites.name: On a Noetherian scheme the derived pushforward of a quasi-coherent module is represented by a complex of quasi-coherent modules, and every quasi-coherent module is the filtered union of its coherent submodules
standard_prerequisites.use: Lets a hypothetical nonzero H^1 be detected by a coherent module F mapping nontrivially to it.

standard_prerequisites.name: A nonzero map to the cohomology of Rj_*G corresponds by adjunction and duality with a finite locally free module to a nonzero class in the Cech cohomology H^1 of an open, which vanishes over affines
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the contradiction from the resolution property.

core_obligations: Combine Limits, Proposition approximate with Lemma resolution-property-descends to reduce to the case where X is Noetherian (small detail omitted, recorded in editorial notes) (proof lines 9713-9717).

X x X is covered by the affine opens U x V; by Morphisms, Lemma characterize-affine it suffices to show U  \cap  V = Delta^{-1}(U x V) is affine for all affine U, V, i.e. that the inclusion j : U to X is affine; by Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma criterion-affine-morphism it suffices to show R^1j_*G = 0 for every quasi-coherent G (proof lines 9718-9732).

Represent Rj_*G by a complex H^bullet of quasi-coherent modules using Proposition Noetherian; suppose H^1(H^bullet) is nonzero; write Ker(H^1 to H^2) as the filtered union of its coherent submodules (Properties, Lemma quasi-coherent-colimit-finite-type) and pick a coherent F mapping to it nontrivially after projection to H^1 (proof lines 9733-9748).

Use the resolution property to choose a surjection E to F from a finite locally free E; the composite gives a nonzero map E[-1] to Rj_*G in D(O_X), hence by adjunction a nonzero map j^*E[-1] to G in D(O_U), hence (E finite locally free, dualize) a nonzero element of H^1(U, j^*E^dual tensor G); but U is affine so this group vanishes by Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma quasi-coherent-affine-cohomology-zero — contradiction (proof lines 9749-9775).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the Noetherian case by approximation and descent (proof lines 9713-9717).
Reduce affinity of the diagonal to vanishing of R^1j_* on affine opens (proof lines 9718-9732).
Detect a hypothetical nonzero H^1 by a coherent module (proof lines 9733-9748).
Contradict affine vanishing of H^1 via the resolution property, adjunction and duality (proof lines 9749-9775).
